title: GE bracket 101: four-case displacement analysis
prompt:
Design task: the GE jet engine bracket. Units: millimetres, newtons, MPa. Material: Ti-6Al-4V (E = 113.8 GPa, nu = 0.342, density 4.43 g/cm^3, yield strength 903 MPa). The bracket is bolted to a flat mounting surface, the plane z = 0, with nothing below it, and carries a clevis for a pin.
Interfaces: (a) four vertical (+z) bolt holes: diameter 10.668 mm at (x, y) = (0.0000, 0.0000), and diameter 10.3124 mm (0.406 in) at (52.0472, 1.5805); (0.0000, -148.1248); (38.0833, -146.9684); each hole wall must start within 1.0 mm of z = 0 and be at least 5.5 mm long; the bolts are rigid and fully fixed. (b) a clevis of two lugs, each with a bore of diameter 19.1008 mm on the pin axis through (-20.9236, -74.6978, 44.7246) with direction (-0.030352, 0.999539, 0); measured along the axis from that point, the lug bores span 11.112 to 17.463 mm and -17.463 to -11.113 mm; the gap between the lugs must stay empty.
Design envelope: x -41 to 72, y -168 to 22, z 0 to 65 mm. Minimum wall / feature thickness 1.27 mm (at most 2 % of the surface may be thinner). One solid.
Loads, four separate linear static cases, each acting at the point (-21.0359, -75.0647, 44.8010) and spread over the two lug bores (RBE3): (1) vertical: 35,585.77 N along +z; (2) horizontal: 37,809.90 N along -x; (3) diagonal, 42 degrees from vertical: (-28,276.20, 0, 31,403.90) N; (4) torsion: 564,924.20 N mm about +z.
The attached STEP is a published competition design. Compute the maximum displacement magnitude for each of the four load cases. Targets are the original published OptiStruct displacement maxima; no locally computed stress target or pass verdict is scored.


Outputs:
- vertical_max_displacement_mm [mm]: maximum displacement magnitude, vertical case
- horizontal_max_displacement_mm [mm]: maximum displacement magnitude, horizontal case
- diagonal_max_displacement_mm [mm]: maximum displacement magnitude, diagonal case
- torsion_max_displacement_mm [mm]: maximum displacement magnitude, torsion case

Submit results.json containing exactly an outputs object with these numeric keys.

title: GE bracket 121: redesign to pass all four load cases
prompt:
Design task: the GE jet engine bracket. Units: millimetres, newtons, MPa. Material: Ti-6Al-4V (E = 113.8 GPa, nu = 0.342, density 4.43 g/cm^3, yield strength 903 MPa). The bracket is bolted to a flat mounting surface, the plane z = 0, with nothing below it, and carries a clevis for a pin.
Interfaces: (a) four vertical (+z) bolt holes: diameter 10.668 mm at (x, y) = (0.0000, 0.0000), and diameter 10.3124 mm (0.406 in) at (52.0472, 1.5805); (0.0000, -148.1248); (38.0833, -146.9684); each hole wall must start within 1.0 mm of z = 0 and be at least 5.5 mm long; the bolts are rigid and fully fixed. (b) a clevis of two lugs, each with a bore of diameter 19.1008 mm on the pin axis through (-20.9236, -74.6978, 44.7246) with direction (-0.030352, 0.999539, 0); measured along the axis from that point, the lug bores span 11.112 to 17.463 mm and -17.463 to -11.113 mm; the gap between the lugs must stay empty.
Design envelope: x -41 to 72, y -168 to 22, z 0 to 65 mm. Minimum wall / feature thickness 1.27 mm (at most 2 % of the surface may be thinner). One solid.
Loads, four separate linear static cases, each acting at the point (-21.0359, -75.0647, 44.8010) and spread over the two lug bores (RBE3): (1) vertical: 35,585.77 N along +z; (2) horizontal: 37,809.90 N along -x; (3) diagonal, 42 degrees from vertical: (-28,276.20, 0, 31,403.90) N; (4) torsion: 564,924.20 N mm about +z.
Pass criterion: in every case the peak von Mises stress (nodal-averaged, first-order tetrahedra of about 1.2 mm) outside 2 mm of the bolt-hole and lug-bore walls is at most 903 MPa.
The attached STEP file is a real competition design (0.591 kg) that fails: in the vertical case its peak stress is 2402 MPa (safety factor 0.38). Change it so it passes all four cases, keeping its bolt holes and lug bores exactly (same diameters and positions), with a mass of at most 0.738 kg. main.py must write part.step (your redesigned single solid, millimetres, same frame as the input) and results.json {"outputs": {"mass_kg": ..., "vertical_peak_von_mises_MPa": ..., "horizontal_peak_von_mises_MPa": ..., "diagonal_peak_von_mises_MPa": ..., "torsion_peak_von_mises_MPa": ...}, "verdict": "pass" or "fail"}.
